articles.title: Watch: Flooding brings Gaza's Civil Defence to declare maximum state of emergency
articles.titleEn: Watch: Flooding brings Gaza's Civil Defence to declare maximum state of emergency
articles.description: Watch: Flooding brings Gaza's Civil Defence to declare maximum state of emergency Heavy rainfall and strong winds have flooded tens of thousands of displacement tents across Gaza, leaving families exposed to rising floodwaters, freezing conditions and worsening humanitarian needs. Gaza's civil defence declared a maximum state of emergency as overwhelmed rescue teams struggled to respond to thousands of distress calls amid limited resources and inadequate shelter. Rescue teams received over 2000 distress calls since the storm began, while only having capacity to respond to a tenth of the calls received. articles.title: Gaza sandbank collapse kills five amid heavy rains
articles.titleEn: Gaza sandbank collapse kills five amid heavy rains
articles.description: Gaza sandbank collapse kills five amid heavy rains At least five people have been killed, including three children, after heavy rains caused a sandbank to collapse in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah, Wafa news reported on Sunday. A civil defence spokesman added that five wounded people had been pulled out of the rubble after their tents were hit, and teams are continuing to search for survivors. The incident comes amid worsening conditions faced by displaced Palestinians in Gaza, as national and internation institutions warned heavy rainfall and bad weather require urgent intervention and the provision of safe shelter and winter supplies.
